resumeFacts: Max Lee Sian Yi is an Account Executive in Singapore.
At Docusign, Max was promoted four times in five years, progressing from SDR to Majors AE.
Max currently manages a US$3 million book of business, the largest commercial territory in Docusign Asia.
As a Mid Market AE in 2025, Max reached 126% attainment, closed US$1.2 million ARR, 17 new logos, and a 31% upsell rate.
In 2024 H2, Max reached 104% attainment, closed US$771k ARR, 6 new logos, and a 24% upsell rate.
Max used MEDDPICC, POC criteria, and mutual success plans to improve close rates from 22% to 31% and shorten sales cycles from 6 months to 5 months.
Max used Gemini and Glean for account and persona research, reducing account research time by 55%, increasing pipeline by 25%, and improving reply rates by 4%.
Max was the first AE in Docusign Asia to sell two newly launched AI product lines within the first month, before established playbooks existed.
Max closed one of the first major Docusign Intelligent Agreement Management platform deals at US$120k ARR.

Max built a private OpenAI BDR Interviewer Buddy that records spoken answers, transcribes with OpenAI speech-to-text, scores answers with structured AI feedback, and stores progress in Supabase without retaining raw audio.
Max built Crib Stock Taker, a household stock taking app with Supabase Auth, roles, low-stock tracking, perishables, private photo storage, and Vercel hosting.

projects.title: OpenAI BDR Interviewer Buddy
projects.kicker: Voice practice coach for OpenAI interview fluency
projects.summary: A private record-and-review practice app that helps Max prepare crisp spoken answers on OpenAI products, AI concepts, competitor positioning, and APAC customer value.
description: This app is not a generic quiz tool. It is an interview-performance training system built around daily five-question voice sessions, topic mastery, retry logic, and commercially grounded feedback.

The browser captures a single answer, sends temporary audio to the backend, transcribes it with OpenAI speech-to-text, then discards the raw audio. The transcript is evaluated with structured AI scoring across technical accuracy, simple explanation, business relevance, OpenAI positioning, interview structure, and concision.

The app also includes production plumbing for Supabase persistence, private login placeholders, daily practice, manual practice modes, topic mastery, and a future freshness review queue for approved OpenAI and competitor source updates.
highlights: Backend-only OpenAI API calls so keys never touch the browser.
Daily adaptive flow from foundation to business translation, scenario, objection handling, and BDR close.
Transcript-first feedback with stronger answer, factual corrections, retry prompts, and mastery updates.
Designed for Singapore and APAC commercial fluency, not generic AI trivia.

projects.title: Crib Stock Taker
projects.kicker: Mobile household stock and perishables tracker
projects.summary: A mobile-friendly household stock taking app for tracking daily necessities and food that should be consumed soon.
description: Crib Stock Taker was built for a small household team with two admins and one helper. The helper-facing workflow uses large controls, clear item names, optional photos, and minimal settings so daily updates stay simple.

The app tracks stock items like toilet paper, detergent, rice, sauces, and cleaning supplies, plus one-off perishables like vegetables, fruit, bread, cake, and takeaway food. Attention counts show low-stock items and perishables that have reached their alert day.
Supabase powers authentication, roles, database tables, and private photo storage. The frontend is a static HTML, CSS, and JavaScript app hosted on Vercel.
highlights: Admin and helper roles with different levels of control.
Batch stock updates with pending edits, save, discard, and leave-page warnings.
Perishable alerts default to two days and support optional photos and notes.
Supabase Auth profiles connect app-specific roles to real users.
projects.role: Solo builder for a real household workflow.

workStories.title: AI-assisted account research
workStories.summary: Used Gemini and Glean to compress account research, sharpen persona insights, identify buying signals, and personalize outreach.
details: Max used AI to make pre-call and prospecting research faster and more precise. The workflow supported account planning, persona research, value-based positioning, and buying-signal discovery.
The measurable outcome from the resume: account research time fell by 55%, overall pipeline increased by 25%, and reply rates improved by 4%.
highlights: Turned research into value-based positioning instead of generic outreach.
Used AI as leverage inside a human sales process, not as a replacement for qualification.
Connected AI-assisted preparation to pipeline and reply-rate outcomes.

workStories.title: Building with Codex
workStories.summary: Used Codex to build and ship personal tools, including this portfolio, the interview-practice app, and the household stock tracker.
details: The local project history shows Max using Codex-style workflows to turn product specs into working apps, connect services like Supabase and Vercel, and iterate from product decisions into implementation.
For this portfolio, Codex was used to inspect source material, mirror a requested reference layout, and build a recruiter-facing site grounded in resume, portfolio, and project material.
highlights: Uses AI as a builder and reviewer across product, code, copy, and deployment.
Keeps AI claims grounded in resume, portfolio, and project source material.
Turns vague product ideas into usable internal tools.
